question.text: Rho measures the change in option premium for a change in:

answer.text: Risk-free interest rate - positive for calls, negative for puts
Volatility - same for calls and puts

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines Rho as the option-price change for a change in the risk-free interest rate. When rates rise, call premiums increase and put premiums decrease. The Trap: Volatility sensitivity is Vega. Time sensitivity is Theta. Underlying price sensitivity is Delta. Each Greek measures sensitivity to a specific factor and Rho is uniquely tied to interest rates. Note: The directional sign (positive for calls, negative for puts) follows directly from how a higher risk-free rate affects the discounting of the strike in option valuation.
